 One of the worst offensive squads in MLS meets the No. 3 team in the league defensively when Seattle Sounders FC (42 goals scored, 26th in league) hosts Los Angeles FC (38 goals conceded) at 7 p.m. ET on Saturday.
 Watch every MLS match, Leagues Cup and the MLS Cup Playoffs on Apple TV+! Use our link to start a free trial now. 
 Seattle vs. LAFC TV & Live Stream Info 
 When: Saturday, November 7, 2026 at 7 p.m. ET
 Where: Lumen Field in Seattle, Washington
 TV: Tubi and Apple TV
 Live Stream: Watch this match on Apple TV+ 
 Tickets: Get tickets for this match on Vivid Seats 
 Seattle Sounders FC’s Top Scorers 
 Seattle’s top scorer this season is Paul Rothrock. He has five goals on 22 shots.
 Another major contributor for Seattle is Cristian Roldan. He has five goals and 10 shots on goal.
 Seattle’s best chance creator this season has been Albert Rusnak. In 32 games he has created 54 chances ending up in 12 assists.
 Los Angeles FC’s Top Scorers 
 Denis Bouanga, LAFC’s top scorer, has 18 goals in 31 games (sixth in league), on 65 shots (2.1 shots per game).
 LAFC has also gotten seven goals in 30 games from Heung Min Son.
 Son is tops on LAFC in chances created as well, with 36 (1.2 per game) plus nine assists.
